alt: Settings on the Appearance page showing six waveform style previews: CueRithm, Dusk, Lagoon, Tonal, Layers and Layers, tonal
caption: The Appearance page previews all six waveform styles on the same sample track.
state: Sidebar: Settings, Appearance page. The Waveform style radio group with the CueRithm style selected and all six samples visible. Dark/light do not matter.

alt: Settings on the Appearance page showing six waveform style previews: CueRithm, Dusk, Lagoon, Tonal, Layers and Layers, tonal
caption: Select a style and every waveform in CueRithm changes at once.
state: Same state as on customize/index.md: Settings, Appearance page, CueRithm style selected.

alt: The player with the Layers style: Come To Life (Original Mix) with its waveform drawn as separate bass, mid and high layers and the cue buttons below
caption: In a layer style the three bands are separate layers instead of one blended colour.
state: Settings -> Appearance: choose Layers. Back in Tracks, load 'Come To Life (Original Mix)' (7A, 130 BPM, 7/10) so the player waveform and overview show the layers. Afterwards set the style back to CueRithm.

alt: The CueRithm window with the Colour theme button in the header between the status line and Add tracks
caption: The Colour theme button sits in the header of every view.
state: Sidebar: Tracks, library as is, nothing selected, status line showing 'All up to date'. Whole window; the theme button must be visible and not hovered. Captured in both themes by the usual process (set the app to System mode first).

alt: CueRithm with the sidebar collapsed to a narrow rail of icons and the track table using the freed space
caption: A collapsed sidebar is a 60 px rail of icons; hover it to open it over the table.
state: Press Cmd/Ctrl+B in Tracks. Pointer away from the rail so it stays collapsed. Whole window. Press the keys again afterwards.

after: ## Make the player taller or shorter { #player-height }
alt: CueRithm with the sidebar widened to its maximum and the player raised to its maximum height, showing a larger waveform and the cue buttons
caption: Drag the two dividers to give the sidebar and the player more room.
state: Tracks with Come To Life (Original Mix) loaded. Drag the sidebar divider to its right-hand limit (340 px) and the player divider to its upper limit (420 px). Whole window. Restore the defaults (224 px and 270 px) afterwards.

alt: The Settings screen on the Incoming page with the list of nine pages on the left: Incoming, Cue generation, Automatic tagging, Cleanup, File organization, Preparation presets, Library preferences, Smart Playlists and Appearance
caption: Settings has nine pages; Save settings is at the top right.
state: Sidebar: Settings. Incoming page open with ~/Music/Beatport listed as the watch folder and the Save settings button visible. Whole window.
